name: Gasfuli for Business
imageAlt: Gasfuli LPG depot dashboard shown on a laptop
description: Supply-chain visibility platform for LPG operators, covering inventory, orders, delivery workflows, and business-level reporting.
longDescription: Gasfuli is a cloud-based platform giving LPG brands supply-chain visibility across inventory, orders, dispatch, delivery, and business-level reporting. It transforms cylinders into digital assets using QR identities for real-time traceability, then tracks refill and delivery workflows to reduce loss, mitigate unauthorized refills, and support accountability and revenue assurance.
